kept.excerpt: The nominees for Outstanding Variety Series are The Daily Show, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, Last Week Tonight with John Oliver, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert and Saturday Night Live.
kept.relevance: The official nomination announcement establishes that Last Week Tonight is eligible to win and identifies the complete competing field.

kept.excerpt: The Television Academy merged Outstanding Scripted Variety Series and Outstanding Talk Series into Outstanding Variety Series for the 2026 competition. The merged category is an area award: voters answer Yes or No for each nominee, and every nominee reaching 90% Yes receives an Emmy. If no nominee reaches that threshold, the nominee with the highest Yes percentage receives an Emmy.
kept.relevance: The possibility of multiple winners is directly relevant to the market's tie provision and changes how historical single-winner results should inform forecasting.

kept.excerpt: The Emmy Awards calendar lists June 1, 2025–May 31, 2026 as the eligibility period. Final-round voting begins August 17 and ends August 26 at 10:00 PM. The NBC telecast is scheduled for Monday, September 14; the Emmy Awards calendar section is marked updated July 24, 2026.
kept.relevance: The official dated calendar establishes that voting was scheduled to be complete by the experiment cutoff while the ceremony remained upcoming.

kept.excerpt: NBCUniversal and the Television Academy announced that the 78th Emmy Awards would air live on NBC and stream live on Peacock on Monday, September 14 at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT from the Peacock Theater at L.A. Live. The Creative Arts Emmy Awards were scheduled for September 5 and September 6.
kept.relevance: This dated official announcement confirms the ceremony schedule, venue and broadcast sources relevant to eventual resolution.

kept.excerpt: Last Week Tonight won Outstanding Scripted Variety Series for the third time in 2025, after previously winning Variety Talk Series for seven straight years. It also earned its tenth consecutive Emmy for Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series.
kept.relevance: The show's ten consecutive series-category wins across the predecessor categories provide a strong historical base rate, subject to the changed 2026 competition and voting rules.

kept.excerpt: The 2026 nominees in the newly recombined Outstanding Variety Series category include Last Week Tonight, The Daily Show, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert and Saturday Night Live. Stephen Colbert wrapped his 11-year Late Show run in May, while Jimmy Kimmel's suspension the previous September prompted public support before ABC reinstated him.
kept.relevance: The nomination report identifies farewell and public-support narratives that could strengthen competitors against the historically dominant Last Week Tonight.

kept.excerpt: Vanity Fair's August 31 preview names The Late Show With Stephen Colbert its predicted winner for Outstanding Variety Series. Its discussion points to the final season of The Late Show and recalls Colbert's 2014 win for The Colbert Report.
kept.relevance: This expert preview immediately before the cutoff supplies a contemporaneous assessment favoring a rival to Last Week Tonight.
